result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within each priority. The change is in `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`.

I replaced the `ORDER BY t.opened_date, t.id` clause with the same priority `CASE` expression the sales-rep list uses, and updated the Javadoc to say so. Filters are unchanged, so closed tickets and other regions stay out.

`RegionManagerTest`, `SupportTicketTest` and `ClosedTicketsTest` pass offline (`mvn -q -o test`, no failures reported). I did not add a test for the new order, and I did not run the full suite. Nothing is committed.
